name: A Level English Lang: Lectmere
subtitle: A Level English Language labs
shortDescription: Revise A Level English Language for AQA, Edexcel, OCR and Eduqas with hands-on labs, annotated texts, essay plans and adaptive quizzes.
longDescription:
Lectmere is an independent study companion for A Level English Language (AQA 7702, Pearson Edexcel 9EN0, OCR H470, WJEC Eduqas A700QS).

### Learn
- 64 teaching points in ten units: the language toolkit, texts and representation, spoken language, child language acquisition, language diversity, language change, discourses and the 21st century, creative writing and commentary, investigations and board guides.
- Every lesson has an original annotated specimen text: tap a feature to see what it does.
- Switch between Syllabus order and Real-World missions at any time.

### Practise
- Original questions for every point, with instant feedback and links back to the exact section to revisit.
- Adaptive study plan that puts weak points first and schedules reviews.
- Board-style essay plans, unseen-text drills and timed mocks.

### Labs
- Sound Studio (IPA), Feature Hunter, Grammar Spotter, Debate Lens, Transcript Lab, Child Language Lab, Time Machine, Variation Bench, Investigation Bench and Essay Planner.

### Open and Honest
- A Coverage screen lists exactly what is covered for each board and what is not. The app cannot mark your essays or non-exam assessment.
- An optional Curriculum map shows similar content in GCSE, IB and AP English.
- Text size from 50 to 300 percent, phone and tablet layouts, works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
